parts.covers: Checks the recorded use-by dates on fresh deliveries for the eleven followed products; it does not establish whether stock was sold after its use-by date, because sale-to-delivery lot matching is not recorded.
parts.sql: select "fresh-deliveries-june"."sku" as "sku", count(*) as "deliveries", sum("fresh-deliveries-june"."units") as "units_delivered", min("fresh-deliveries-june"."use_by") as "earliest_use_by", max("fresh-deliveries-june"."use_by") as "latest_use_by" from "fresh-deliveries-june"  where (substr("fresh-deliveries-june"."use_by",1,10) between ? and ?) group by "fresh-deliveries-june"."sku" order by "sku" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From fresh-delivery row records; keep rows where fresh deliveries.use_by between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by fresh deliveries.sku; report sku = fresh deliveries.sku, deliveries = count of *, units_delivered = sum of fresh deliveries.units, earliest_use_by = min of fresh deliveries.use_by, latest_use_by = max of fresh deliveries.use_by; sorted by sku asc.

parts.covers: Reports recorded damaged and expired write-offs per product as evidence of food-safety handling; it does not record the cause of any waste or whether non-written-off expired stock remained on the shelf.
parts.sql: select "write-offs-june"."sku" as "sku", "write-offs-june"."reason" as "reason", count(*) as "write_off_events", sum("write-offs-june"."units") as "units_written_off" from "write-offs-june"  where (substr("write-offs-june"."date",1,10) between ? and ?) group by "write-offs-june"."sku", "write-offs-june"."reason" order by "sku" asc, "reason" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From write-off records; keep rows where write offs.date between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by write offs.sku, write offs.reason; report sku = write offs.sku, reason = write offs.reason, write_off_events = count of *, units_written_off = sum of write offs.units; sorted by sku asc, reason asc.

parts.covers: Lists the recorded product identifiers, names and pack descriptions for the eleven followed products as the available labelling evidence; it does not verify that shelf labels, expiry labels or declarations actually matched these records.
parts.sql: select "products"."sku" as "sku", "products"."name" as "name", "products"."pack" as "pack", "products"."gtin" as "gtin" from "products"  order by "sku" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From product records; report sku = products.sku, name = products.name, pack = products.pack, gtin = products.gtin; sorted by sku asc.
